:new: New project intention · #54 Formalization of Lubin–Tate theory

The goal of this project is to formalize in Lean 4 the results of Jonathan Lubin and John Tate’s paper Formal Complex Multiplication in Local Fields (1965), using and extending Mathlib.

The project covers the construction of Lubin–Tate formal groups over the ring of integers of a nonarchimedean local field, their endomorphisms and torsion points, and the abelian extensions generated by these torsion points. The ultimate objective is to formalize the paper’s explicit description of local reciprocity.

Reference: Jonathan Lubin and John Tate, Formal Complex Multiplication in Local Fields, Annals of Mathematics 81 (1965), 380–387.
